public_body: Hyannis Main Street Business Improvement District
overall: The AG found the Hyannis Main Street BID Board is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law, so it could not have violated the Law, and closed the matter.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the BID Board of Directors failed to follow Open Meeting Law requirements; the AG first asked whether the Board is a public body at all.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that the Board is not a public body subject to the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.
